$description: Pepper Me design tokens v1.0. Three layers: primitive, semantic, component. Primitives are raw values and must never be referenced directly by a component. Contrast ratios are computed, not estimated.

ink.$description: Ink. Primary text, dark grounds, wordmark. 19.44:1 on Paper.

ink-80.$description: Ink 80. Dark ground alternate, pressed state on dark surfaces. 13.98:1 on Paper.

ink-60.$description: Ink 60. Secondary text, standfirsts, helper copy. 6.55:1 on Paper, 5.76:1 on Cream. Safe for body copy on both.

ink-40.$description: Ink 40. Disabled control labels and non-text UI only. 3.29:1 on Paper. NEVER body copy.

ink-30.$description: Ink 30. Decorative only. 2.47:1 on Paper. NEVER text at any size.

ink-20.$description: Ink 20. Inactive borders, form field borders, reference interval segment fill.

ink-10.$description: Ink 10. Hairline rules, card outlines, table row rules. The default border in the system.

cream.$description: Cream. Secondary ground, alternating sections, disclaimer blocks, the Her side of the fork block. Ink sits on it at 17.09:1.

peach.$description: Peach. Tint ground for editorial breaks, used sparingly. Ink sits on it at 14.4:1.

paper.$description: Paper. Page ground, card surface, inverse text on Ink and on action fills.

pepper-700.$description: Pepper 700. Primary action hover and pressed, error text. 6.75:1 on Paper.

pepper-600.$description: Pepper 600. THE ACTION FILL. Paper label on this passes AA at body size at 5.39:1. Use this for every filled button, not Pepper 500.

pepper-500.$description: Pepper 500. THE BRAND MARK. Wordmark period, large display accents, out-of-range indicator on the reference range bar. 4.35:1 on Paper, which FAILS AA for body text and fails with a white label. Never use as a button fill.

pepper-400.$description: Pepper 400. Accent on Ink grounds only. 6.04:1 on Ink.

pepper-300.$description: Pepper 300. Emphasis on Ink grounds. 8.72:1 on Ink.

pepper-50.$description: Pepper 50. Out-of-range row tint on the reference range bar. Surface only, never text.

lab-700.$description: Lab 700. Link pressed, high-emphasis technical text. 8.84:1 on Paper.

lab-500.$description: Lab 500. Section tags, mono metadata layer, in-text links, focus ring. 6.03:1 on Paper, 5.30:1 on Cream, 4.46:1 on Peach. FAILS on Ink at 3.23:1.

lab-300.$description: Lab 300. The mono metadata layer and links on Ink grounds. 8.61:1 on Ink.

lab-50.$description: Lab 50. Selected state and in-range highlight. Surface only.

text-inverse.$description: Text on Ink grounds and on action fills.

text-technical.$description: The mono metadata layer: biomarker names, section tags, units, dates.

text-technical-inverse.$description: The mono metadata layer on Ink grounds.

text-alert.$description: Out-of-range values and form error messages.

surface-raised.$description: Level 1. Cards. Distinguished from page by hairline, never by shadow.

surface-muted.$description: Level 2. Alternating sections, disclaimers, table row hover, Her fork panel.

surface-tint.$description: Level 3. Editorial break sections. Used sparingly.

surface-inverse.$description: Level 4. Dark sections, footer, Him fork panel.

surface-alert.$description: Level 5. Out-of-range row on the reference range bar. No other use.

border-hairline.$description: Default 1px border on cards, tables and rules.

border-strong.$description: Emphasis border, card hover, active state.

border-inactive.$description: Form field default border and disabled control border.

action-fill.$description: Primary button fill on light grounds.

action-fill-inverse.$description: Primary button fill on Ink grounds, with Ink label.

mark.$description: Wordmark period and the out-of-range indicator. Maximum twice per viewport.

focus-ring.$description: 2px ring at 2px offset on every interactive element. Clears 3:1 on Paper, Cream and Peach.

display.$description: Headlines, pillar statements, hero, prices. Sentence case only, never uppercase, never positive tracking. Substitutes: Archivo, Anton, Bebas Neue.

editorial.$description: Single-line editorial statements and pull quotes. Maximum twice per page. Never body, never headings, never inside a card. Substitutes: EB Garamond Italic, Newsreader Italic.

body.$description: Body, UI, navigation, forms, buttons, tables. Measure caps at 68 characters, 72 in article body. Substitutes: Inter, Public Sans.

mono.$description: The metadata layer. Biomarker names, units, reference ranges, section tags, dates, AHPRA registration numbers, review dates. Present on every page, never decorative. Substitutes: IBM Plex Mono, Roboto Mono.

h2.$description: Section heading. Also used for tier prices.

h4.$description: Minor heading, FAQ question, doctor name. Body face, not display.

editorial.$description: Editorial statement and pull quote. Maximum twice per page.

body.$description: Default body. 16px minimum on mobile for a 35 to 60 audience.

body-sm.$description: Dense body, card copy, footer links.

caption.$description: Image captions, legal block, fine print.

mono.$description: Section tags, biomarker names, table headers. The metadata layer.

mono-sm.$description: Units, reference intervals, dates, registration numbers. Sentence case for values.

unit.$description: Base unit. All spacing is a multiple of 8, except space-1 at 4.

4.$description: Default element gap, mono tag to block.

5.$description: Card padding mobile, paragraph gap, grid column gap.

none.$description: THE DEFAULT. Cards, buttons, inputs, images, tables, containers. The absence of radius is the identity and it is applied without exception.

sm.$description: Chips, tags, badges. The only softening permitted in the system.

full.$description: Avatars and the status dot only. NEVER a button.

none.$description: The only shadow token in the system. Elevation is a hairline and a ground change, never a shadow.

grid-gap.$description: Grid column gap at all breakpoints.

md.$description: Tablet. Fork block stacks below this.

lg.$description: Small desktop. Sticky TOC appears at this width.

2xl.$description: Large desktop. Gutters grow, container does not.

sticky.$description: Sticky header and table of contents.

au.com.pepperme.compliance.note: Visual tokens can constitute prohibited advertising. See Website Build Brief section 03.
au.com.pepperme.compliance.referenceRangeBarRules: May display value, unit and reference interval only. Must never display an interpretation, recommendation, target, or directional arrow implying a desired change.

failingPairsDocumented: pepper-500 on paper 4.35:1 — fails AA normal text, use pepper-600
paper on pepper-500 4.35:1 — fails AA normal text, use pepper-600 as fill
lab-500 on ink 3.23:1 — fails, use lab-300 on dark grounds
ink-40 on paper 3.29:1 — non-text UI only
